summary.text: Father of Pylaemenes (`pylaemenes-paphlagon`) — attested by Apollodorus when the Paphlagonian captain joined the Trojans after nine years of siege, while Homer names the son but not his sire in the Catalogue.

story.text: Homer's Catalogue sets Pylaemenes of the shaggy heart at the head of the Paphlagonians from the land of the Eneti — men who held Cytorus and dwelt about Sesamon and the river Parthenius — but does not name his father in the muster.
Apollodorus, listing the allies who came to Troy in the ninth year, makes Pylaemenes son of Bilsates among the Paphlagonian captains.
